references.text: Solomon's wisdom included riddles and difficult questions, showing that riddles were part of the wisdom tradition in Israel
Proverbs mentions riddles as part of wisdom, indicating that riddles were used to test discernment
Ezekiel uses the word 'riddle' for a parable, illustrating how riddles were employed to convey deeper truths
The actual riddle that Samson posed to the Philistines at the wedding feast
The solution to the riddle and how the Philistines obtained the answer through Samson's wife
Joseph gave his brothers changes of clothing, demonstrating the same type of gift that Samson promised as a reward
